name: danny-skills
description: Personal skill pack. Pipeline: dt-plan -> dt-visualize-plan -> optional dt-prototype -> dt-review -> dt-roadmap -> dt-build, with dt-visualize-design rendering finalized designs. Authoring: dt-tune (approval-gated SKILL.md amendments). Session hygiene: dt-session-audit (autonomous end-of-session capture across CLAUDE.md / MEMORY.md / CONTEXT.md / glossary.md), dt-memory-hygiene (periodic bloat cleanup), dt-handoff (single-use session continuity). Workstation: dt-app-launcher (hardened local GUI launchers), dt-terminal-format-profile (deterministic VS Code terminal colors). Writing: dt-writing-draft and dt-writing-edit (sourced drafting and editing for letters, papers, copy). Git: git-sync-features, git-merge-feature (rebase-forward feature workflow).

changelog: 0.9.19 dt-build-acceptance-contract-gate: dt-build (v2.2.0 -> v2.3.0) now enforces a per-milestone verify-before-complete acceptance contract instead of verify-at-end. New reference: skills/dt-build/references/acceptance-contract.md (the binding contract — quote verification check, build chunk, run named pytest/script command, scan for downgrade language, append acceptance row, only then advance). New scripts: skills/dt-build/scripts/verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1 (extracts artifacts the roadmap names per milestone, checks presence in the working tree, with -RunTests runs named pytest/python commands and folds exit codes into PASS/BLOCKED verdict), skills/dt-build/scripts/check-downgrade-language.ps1 (banned-phrase scanner calibrated against the 2026-05-27 file-sorter learning-loop post-mortem; flags 'compatible fallback', 'deterministic fallback', 'hash fallback', 'production can replace', 'scaffold implementation', 'verifier passes' paired with artifact-missing context, etc., with downgrade_approved_by: danny block override), skills/dt-build/scripts/identify-load-bearing.ps1 (parses roadmap, flags milestones whose name/acceptance/verification text contains load-bearing / gate / publish / persistence / runtime-flip / E2E / critical-path triggers; build orders these first within their DAG layer), skills/dt-build/scripts/build-acceptance-ledger.ps1 (aggregates per-milestone results into build-acceptance-ledger.md + build-acceptance-ledger.html with the four-axis split: implemented / tested / accepted / status, plus blockers and downgrade-language matches). The ledger replaces the freeform build summary as the build's final answer. Closes the failure class where a build is reported complete while load-bearing E2E coverage, named integration hooks, real model artifacts, and state-machine guards are missing or substituted with placeholders that satisfy thinner tests.

0.9.18 determinism-composability-extractions: extracted five AI-interpreted procedures to deterministic scripts and consolidated two shared patterns. New scripts: skills/git-sync-features/scripts/sync-features.ps1 (whole-skill git sequence), skills/git-merge-feature/scripts/merge-feature.ps1 (rebase + ff-merge + delete), scripts/git/rebase-onto-dev.ps1 (shared rebase helper called by both), skills/dt-app-launcher/scripts/verify-launcher.ps1 (Edge hardening + .lnk target verification, replaces hand-interpreted bullet checklist; dt-app-launcher bumped 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0), skills/dt-writing-edit/scripts/next-edit-version.ps1 (deterministic edit-version filename resolution), skills/dt-handoff/scripts/prep-handoff-folder.ps1 (folder prep + existing-file listing + canonical save-paths). New references: references/voice-load-order.md (canonical three-layer voice-reference load order, replaces inline restatement in dt-writing-draft + dt-writing-edit). Consolidated references/conventions.md with the output-paths convention (bare absolute paths, no computer:// links), pointer-swapped from dt-writing-draft, dt-writing-edit, dt-plan (1.0.1 -> 1.0.2), and dt-visualize-plan (1.0.1 -> 1.0.2). No visibility/frontmatter changes.

0.9.17 dt-build-skill-propagation-gate: dt-build (v2.2.0) now runs a final-gate skill-junction reconciler whenever the built repo is danny-skills. The new repo-level scripts\verify-skill-junctions.ps1 diffs skills/ between the merge base and the build branch, materializes per-skill directory junctions across $CODEX_HOME\skills, ~\.agents\skills, D:\Claude\skills, and _Claude-Workspace\.claude\skills, and hard-fails the build on any missing/wrong-target/setup-gap/orphan result. Same script is callable ad-hoc as a one-shot sweep. Closes the recurring invisible-new-skill gap that hid dt-app-launcher from Codex and dt-prototype from two of the four CLI surfaces until the 2026-05-26 manual backfill.

0.9.16 dt-review-final-only-retention: changed dt-review so only design-final.md is retained after successful finalization, moved round prompts/reviews/logs/drafts into design\_review scratch state, and removed retained review archaeology from the final design contract. (Originally shipped as 0.9.13 on main; renumbered when merged onto dev to avoid collision with dev's 0.9.13 dt-app-launcher entry.)

0.9.15 manifest-description-refresh: rewrote plugin.json and marketplace.json descriptions to enumerate all 19 shipped skills grouped by role (pipeline / authoring / hygiene / workstation / writing / git). No skill behavior change.

0.9.14 dt-app-launcher: added python_gui mode that generates direct pythonw.exe desktop/start menu shortcuts for standalone app windows (no terminal), plus explicit no-bat shortcut guardrails and verification.

0.9.13 dt-app-launcher: added deterministic Windows standalone launcher scaffolding with hardened Edge app-mode profile, sync/extension suppression, shortcut generation, stop cleanup, and smoke-test contract.

0.9.12 dt-terminal-format-profile-companion-mode: added a paired repo-plus-workstation-root mode with deterministic companion shade derivation and fixed OrderedDictionary-safe settings writes for the VS Code terminal color script.
0.9.11 dt-terminal-format-profile: added a deterministic workspace-local VS Code terminal color skill plus a reusable PowerShell script for requests like 'make this repo color blue'.

0.9.10 html-mermaid-rendering: made HTML review artifacts treat Mermaid as a rendered diagram only, hardened dt-visualize-plan/design runtime initialization, and added scripted dt-roadmap roadmap-view.html generation with browser-verifiable SVG output.

0.9.9 session-audit-autonomy-and-hygiene: renamed dt-starter-session-audit to dt-session-audit, switched deterministic non-conflict session capture to autonomous apply mode, added dt-memory-hygiene plus deterministic bloat detection thresholds, and wired post-audit auto-trigger for hygiene when thresholds trip.
0.9.9 pre-value-review-live-testing: promoted current dev state for live testing prior to formal Value Review gate completion.

0.8.0 phase-8-dt-tune-and-audit-extension: added dt-tune for approval-gated skill-level SKILL.md amendments, extended dt-session-audit with the skill-amendment routing class, and standardized per-skill _log.md friction-note convention plus session-end tune stop-hook guidance.

0.8.0 phase-7b-dt-build-execution: completed dt-build execution parity by adding deterministic execution scripts (assemble-codex-prompt, verify-codex-prompt, dev-cas-update), wiring codex prompt verify-gate and dev compare-and-swap flow, and preserving Phase-7A roadmap-intake contract behavior.

0.7.0 phase-0-foundation: repo-level references/scripts/assets scaffolding; canonical dimension contract + glossary contract single sources; security primitives (wrap-prompt-envelope, redact-secrets) + redaction corpus; vendored mermaid 10.9.3 (SHA256-pinned); upstream-deps governance + fallback table; skill-template scaffold.

0.7.0 phase-1-dt-plan: renamed dt-design-build -> dt-plan onto the Anthropic standard (SKILL.md 2.2k words); CDC + glossary-placement rules now point at repo-level references; surface templates + plan-shape/shape_version policy extracted to dt-plan/references; junction reparse-target resolution added to conventions.md; junctions repaired on CLI x3 + Codex; live cross-skill references updated; no plugin version bump (milestone-based policy).

0.7.0 phase-2-dt-visualize-plan: added dt-visualize-plan (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill) plus shared visualize runtime (html-builder + mermaid-wrap + template/tokens); renders plan-view.html with milestone table, optional mermaid graph/gantt, fallback dependency provenance footer, and vendored mermaid-only loading.

0.7.0 phase-3-dt-prototype: added dt-prototype (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill) adapted from Matt Pocock's MIT prototype pattern; split logic/UI branches under references/ with vendored starter templates for terminal TUI (TypeScript/Python) and UI variant switching; dt-plan now routes behavior-validatable questions through dt-prototype before adversarial review.

0.7.0 phase-4-dt-review: renamed dt-design-loop -> dt-review with Anthropic-standard frontmatter; extracted input modes, codex prompt template, recovery, finalization, and design-shape contracts into dt-review/references; pointer-swapped CDC to repo-level canonical contract; added deterministic round scripts (preflight, invoke, verdict parse, provenance capture); updated cross-skill references and junction topology for CLI/Codex surfaces.

0.7.0 phase-5-dt-visualize-design: added dt-visualize-design (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill), section-level markdown diff engine, and shared design-diff rendering mode that outputs design-view.html with [ADDED]/[CHANGED]/[REMOVED] badges, change-summary header, and Phase-2-equivalent dependency provenance fallback behavior.

0.7.0 phase-6-dt-roadmap: added dt-roadmap (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill), canonical roadmap schema contract (producer_current_version + schema_version: 1), roadmap validator (cycle/independence/parallelism/schema major-match checks), milestones exporter with xlsx primary and csv+markdown fallback, and Phase-2 mermaid/shared-security primitive reuse.

0.7.0 phase-7a-dt-build-intake: refactored dt-build for roadmap-driven intake parity (Anthropic-standard split with assets/references/scripts), added deterministic intake scaffolding scripts and hard-cutover rejection for pre-refactor .dt-build run folders, and wired intake validation to dt-roadmap's canonical validator/schema via repo-relative path.
